sloka: तौ तु दीर्घेण कालेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।रावणस्य पुरीं लङ्कामासेदतुररिन्दमौ ।। ६.४१.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: tau tu dīrgheṇa kālena bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।rāvaṇasya purīṁ laṅkāmāsedaturarindamau ।। 6.41.29 ।।।।

translations.english: The monkeys who were of the size of elephants capable of warding off the enemy, bore huge grown up trees in their hands and went.
